subject: Define LIBDIVIDE_INLINE as __forceinline for ms compiler
change_summary: Uses __forceinline for LIBDIVIDE_INLINE under Microsoft compiler.

units.name: Uses __forceinline for LIBDIVIDE_INLINE under Microsoft compiler.
units.evidence: Eight of ten default Linux public targets prove bidirectionally; unsigned32 and unsigned64 recovery targets time out. Linux no-asm mode proves all ten; MSVC-mode recovery targets also time out.

notes: The compiler-mode change needs the actual MSVC paths; current LLVM checks are inconclusive for two recovery APIs.
